notes_for_editor: The register is the only source for the 1934 CCC build by a New Jersey crew and for the 100-ft height; two searches and the cached pages found no corroboration. A Living New Deal search result about CCC work at the Airey Work Center (De Soto NF, 1935) is a different site and was not used. The register's 'former Black Warrior Ranger District' label is uncorroborated and was left out of the story. The WDAM report (February 2026) places a wildfire near Paret Tower Road but does not say it reached the tower. Height converted from 100 ft. The record's standing status rests on a 2003 description. The WDAM date (February 22, 2026) comes from the article's published-time metadata; the visible text has no date.
